name: search
description: Configure the next web search in this conversation. The hosted tool uses the conversation history and returns citations. Only query is required.

parameters.description: Options apply to this search only.

query.description: The question to research. Include the subject and any relevant dates.

filters.description: Restrict the sources for this search.

allowed_domains.description: Limit results to these domains and their subdomains. Use hostnames without a scheme.

blocked_domains.description: Exclude these domains and their subdomains. Use hostnames without a scheme.

search_context_size.description: Amount of search context. Use low for a quick lookup or high for detailed research.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles.

search_content_types.description: Request text, images, or both. Omit for ordinary text searches.

image_settings.description: Options for image searches. Include image in search_content_types.

max_results.description: Maximum number of image results to request.
